query:
SELECT weekNumber, weekStartDate, campus, subgroup, headcount 
FROM attendance_weekly 
WHERE year = 2026 AND weekNumber IN (19, 20)
  AND subgroup IN ('Revolution Canton Check-In', 'Revolution Jasper Check-In', 'Revolution Church Jasper', 'Kids', 'RevStudents HS', 'RevStudents MS', 'Online', 'Volunteers')
ORDER BY campus, subgroup, weekNumber;
